import_detectron_ops: import the Detectron custom ops library into the current Caffe2 runtime session
create_suffix_net: create a new Caffe2 Net that includes only the ops after a given prefix length
create_cuda_scope: create a GPU name scope and CUDA device scope for a given GPU id
unscope_blob_name: remove name scoping from a scoped blob name like gpu_0/foo to get foo
create_gaussian_fill: create a GaussianFill operator helper tuple with a specified standard deviation value
